name: Twenty-year mobile production platform development and cost history (2006–2026)
aliases: Twenty-year mobile production platform development and cost history (2006–2026)
principle: A 20-year retrospective of mobile production platforms, assembled from dated project, technology, vendor and cost evidence with sources and dollar years where published.

performance.metric: Operational history — SBM opens Kuala Lumpur execution centre
performance.basis: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia execution centre opened to execute large and complex projects.

performance.metric: Operational history — FPSO Aseng delivered two years after contract award
performance.basis: Delivered two months ahead of schedule; 120,000 bbl/d liquids, 1.6 million bbl storage.

performance.metric: Operational history — Generation 3 FPSO enters market; Cidade de Paraty
performance.basis: Cidade de Paraty constructed in 34 months from LOI June 2010, 20-year charter, Lula Nordeste pre-salt, Brazil.

performance.metric: Operational history — Fast4Ward programme launched
performance.basis: Standardised Multi-Purpose Floater hull and topsides modules to industrialise FPSO delivery.

performance.metric: Operational history — FPSO Liza Destiny installed offshore Guyana
performance.basis: First installation for oil and gas production in Guyana; first oil 20 December 2019 per SBM annual report extract.

performance.metric: Operational history — First oil from first Fast4Ward FPSO
performance.basis: SBM heritage lists first oil from the first Fast4Ward FPSO (Liza Unity).

performance.metric: Operational history — First F4W FPSO Sepetiba arrives in Brazil
performance.basis: SBM heritage entry.

performance.metric: Reliability — SBM fleet historical uptime
performance.basis: SBM Offshore heritage, 2010 entry: fleet had an uptime average of 99% (over 200 years cumulative operating experience and >3 billion barrels produced)

performance.metric: Reliability — Yinson Production fleet technical uptime FYE2024
performance.basis: Yinson Holdings Integrated Annual Report 2024 business review: 99.7% technical uptime, 100% commercial uptime; 99.7% average 5-year technical uptime

performance.metric: Operational history — First semi-submersible production system, Argyll
performance.basis: Hamilton Brothers installed leased first-generation drilling unit Transworld 58 in 275 ft water depth in the North Sea (historical baseline from the 2000 survey).

performance.metric: Operational history — DeepDraft Semi installed at Independence Hub
performance.basis: World-record 8,000 ft water depth, Gulf of Mexico.

performance.metric: Operational history — First DeepDraft Semi with PHA contract — Thunder Hawk
performance.basis: Murphy Oil contracted a five-year lease of a newbuild semisubmersible FPU for Thunder Hawk, offshore Louisiana.

performance.metric: Reliability — Enchova converted semisubmersible operational efficiency
performance.basis: Offshore Magazine 2000 MOPU survey: Brazil's Sedco 135D at Enchova produced over 8.5 million bbl to July 1980 reaching operational efficiencies of 98%

performance.metric: Operational history — Largest SeaStar TLP delivered (Matterhorn)
performance.basis: SBM heritage: fourth and largest SeaStar TLP delivered to Total for Matterhorn field, Gulf of Mexico.

performance.metric: Operational history — Neptune mini-TLP installed
performance.basis: BSEE Table 1.1: Neptune, BHP, 4,250 ft, single-column mini TLP.

performance.metric: Operational history — Olympus TLP installed
performance.basis: BSEE Table 1.1: Olympus, Shell, 3,028 ft, four-column.

performance.metric: Operational history — Big Foot TLP installed, deepest to date
performance.basis: BSEE Table 1.1: Big Foot, Chevron, 5,200 ft, four-column.

performance.metric: Reliability — TLP tendon design survival criterion
performance.basis: BSEE E17PC00018 report section 1.3: tendons designed for strength to extreme and survival conditions including 1000-year response design criteria with appropriate safety factors

performance.metric: Reliability — minimum fatigue design factor for 'uninspectable' tendon components
performance.basis: BSEE E17PC00018 report section 1.3: tendon components designed with enhanced fatigue safety factor, typically a minimum of 10 times the design life of the TLP

performance.metric: Reliability — share of installed TLPs in US Gulf of Mexico
performance.basis: BSEE E17PC00018 report section 1.1: approximately 67% of TLPs installed to date located in US Gulf of Mexico (as at 2018 report)

performance.metric: Operational history — Neptune spar upended — first production spar
performance.basis: Oryx (later Kerr-McGee) Neptune spar upended September 1996; Ed Horton developed the modern spar design.

performance.metric: Operational history — First cell spar, Red Hawk
performance.basis: Kerr-McGee Red Hawk, full EPCI, hull and topsides fabricated at Technip's Gulf Marine Fabricators; first all wet-tree spar.

performance.metric: Operational history — First offshore production jackup, Gulftide at Ekofisk
performance.basis: Four-leg jackup converted as an early production system; production began 18 months after discovery.

performance.metric: Operational history — TPG 500 newbuild jackup MOPU at Harding
performance.basis: Newbuild in 360 ft water depth, 65,000 b/d oil and 35 MMcf/d gas, on a concrete gravity base storing oil for shuttle tanker export.

performance.metric: Operational history — Maleo gas project first production from converted jack-up MOPU
performance.basis: Indonesia's Madura Strait; converted jack-up rig modernised in Dubai; leased from Radiant Utama Interinsco with Global Process Systems; first gas only 16 months after final investment approval.

performance.metric: Operational history — Prelude enters Lloyd's Register class
performance.basis: 23 August 2017 press release; facility had arrived at Browse Basin operating location the previous month.

performance.metric: Operational history — PFLNG SATU first LNG drop
performance.basis: EIA reports PFLNG Satu produced its first LNG on 5 December 2016 from the Kanowit field offshore Sarawak; PETRONAS LNG quick facts corroborate the date.

performance.metric: Operational history — PFLNG SATU first cargo
performance.basis: 1 April 2017 loaded onto LNG carrier Seri Camellia at Kanowit field; EIA states first cargo delivery completed 20 April 2017.

performance.metric: Operational history — PFLNG SATU 100th cargo
performance.basis: PETRONAS LNG quick facts: 100th cargo December 2024; unit relocated to Kebabangan field offshore Sabah.

performance.metric: Operational history — PFLNG DUA first cargo
performance.basis: PETRONAS LNG quick facts: first gas 6 Feb 2021, first LNG 15 Feb 2021, first cargo 24 March 2021; 1.5 MTPA, up to 1,500 m water depth, 333 m length.

performance.metric: Reliability — Prelude onboard operating crew
performance.basis: Shell Australia fact sheet: team of 120–140 people work onboard during operations; up to 300 during heavy maintenance

performance.metric: Operational history — Excelerate Energy founded
performance.basis: US company founded; developed FSRU concept with vaporisers onboard LNG carriers.

performance.metric: Operational history — Gulf Gateway Deepwater Port commissioned — world's first FSRU facility

performance.metric: Operational history — Teesside Gasport — world's first dockside floating regasification facility
performance.basis: United Kingdom; decommissioned 2015.

performance.metric: Operational history — Exemplar starts supply at Inkoo, Finland
performance.basis: December 2022 arrival; regasified LNG to Finland, Estonia and the Baltic region.

performance.metric: Operational history — Excelerate listed on NYSE
performance.basis: April 2022 per JOGMEC profile.

performance.metric: Operational history — Hull 3407 newbuild FSRU scheduled for 2026
performance.basis: 170,000 m3 newbuild; delivery on schedule for June 2026 per JOGMEC report based on August 2024 information.

performance.metric: Operational history — Penrod 72 drilling semi converted to production semisubmersible
performance.basis: Placid Oil Green Canyon 29 conversion, 1,500 ft water depth; dockside conversion in Galveston took 11 months (page read).

performance.metric: Operational history — Maleo converted jack-up MOPU first gas
performance.basis: Modernised and upgraded in Dubai into a standalone relocatable gas production facility, leased under a multi-year service agreement.

performance.metric: Operational history — LNG carrier Hilli converted to FLNG (Cameroon)

performance.metric: Operational history — Largest internal turret delivered for P-53

performance.metric: Operational history — First turret-moored FPSO with steel catenary risers, Espirito Santo
performance.basis: BC-10 field offshore Brazil; deepest moored FPSO in SBM fleet at the time.

performance.metric: Operational history — 5,500 tonne Skarv turret installed
performance.basis: Bogie-bearing internal turret, Skarv field offshore Norway.

performance.metric: Operational history — COOL LNG transfer system qualified
performance.basis: Described by SBM as the industry's first fully qualified and certified floating offshore LNG transfer system in tandem configuration.

performance.metric: Operational history — VHP swivel rated over 800 bar
performance.basis: SBM heritage milestone.

performance.metric: Operational history — FPSO Turritella installed — deepest moored unit
performance.basis: Shell Stones field, Gulf of Mexico; world's largest disconnectable turret with steel lazy wave risers.

performance.metric: Operational history — Fast4Ward mooring catalogue internal/external/spread
performance.basis: Generic Multi-Purpose Floater hull offered with external, internal and spread mooring from a catalogue of solutions.

performance.metric: Operational history — Fast4Ward modular topsides concept introduced
performance.basis: Generic and bespoke module catalogue; lower module height from ample deck space; earlier vendor engagement to reduce supply-chain costs and construction timelines by up to 12 months.

performance.metric: Operational history — Carbon capture module on an FPSO qualified by DNV
performance.basis: SBM heritage entry.

performance.metric: Operational history — AC high-voltage swivel qualified
performance.basis: Around 150 MW, enabling shore power for large FPSOs.

performance.metric: Operational history — Yinson FPSO Maria Quitéria and Agogo specified with combined-cycle and all-electric drives
performance.basis: Yinson 2024 review: Maria Quitéria has combined cycle power generation and flare gas recovery; Agogo has all-electric drives, closed flare system, hydrocarbon blanketing, combined cycle technology, pilot carbon capture plant and seawater turbine generator; DNV Abate notation on one unit.

performance.metric: Reliability — Yinson FPSO fleet technical uptime (proxy for power/process availability)
performance.basis: Yinson 2024 annual report business review: 99.7% technical uptime and 100% commercial uptime, FYE2024

performance.metric: Operational history — Water injection formalised as a GTS topsides domain
performance.basis: SBM 2016 investor presentation shows 'Topsides Water Injection' among the five GTS standardisation domains.

performance.metric: Reliability — Yinson FYE2024 emissions event linked to compressor train downtime reducing gas reinjection
performance.basis: Yinson 2024 review: 43% of absolute emissions attributed to unexpected flaring on two assets, partly due to technical downtime on a compressor train reducing gas reinjection capacity — a reinjection reliability observation, not a water-injection figure
